cohort: The study included 1562 women recruited from four different tertiary care centers in India.
finding: The study established nomograms for various vulvar and vaginal measurements in Indian women, finding that most external genital measurements, except the clitoris, positively correlated with BMI.
cross-section timing: Adult women at the time of recruitment
